messages:
Ava: Sharing a quick pass on the invite drawer design. Main items: surface SSO status without implying invite-level control, keyboard UX for role chips, inline changelog vs deep-link to Audit Logs, and toast copy. Figma: https://figma.com/file/invite-v4
Ravi: Strong preference to avoid a toggle here. Users expect SSO to be org-scoped. Suggest a small status pill: "SSO enforced (org)" with an info affordance.
Tom: For keyboard, the pill should be tabbable and open a modal explaining scope. Order: email -> roles -> pill -> send. That keeps primary input first.
Ivy: A11y items: pill contrast needs to pass 4.5:1; modal must trap focus; info icon needs aria-label. Also chips should support arrow navigation and a visible 3px focus ring.
Noah: Backend note: we can deep-link to Audit Logs with params (actorId, action=invite, object=member, start, end). We'll support return param so UI can restore drawer state.
Ravi: Copy idea for pill tooltip: "SSO enforcement applies to the entire organization. Change in Organization settings." Short pill label: "SSO enforced".
Tom: For the modal CTA, make the primary keyboard focus the "Go to Organization settings" button so power users can navigate quickly. Esc should return focus to the pill.
Ivy: Toasts: use aria-live=polite and do not autofocus. Change text to "Invites queued 3
Recipients will receive email shortly" (shorter and clarifies async). Provide an inline "View invite status" link in the drawer as a persistent affordance.
DeployBot: Visual diff: invite-drawer-v4 failed for focus-ring color. See CI snapshot.
Ava: Action items: Ravi update Figma with pill + modal copy, Tom add tabbable pill ARIA and keyboard flows, Ivy produce a small a11y checklist (contrast, focus rings, live regions), Noah share example deep-link URLs, I'll schedule a short review tomorrow 11am PT.
Ravi: I'll update and ping when done.
Tom: Adding keyboard/ARIA snippets to PR.
Ivy: Will run axe when updated frames posted.
Noah: Drafting deep-link examples now.
Ava: Thanks all, closing thread unless blockers appear.
